crossRefs.note: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
crossRefs.keyword: count them pure. or, be pure. the wicked

crossRefs.note: Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

translations.web: Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?
translations.bsb: Can I excuse dishonest scales or bags of false weights?
translations.kjv: Shall I count them pure with the wicked balances, and with the bag of deceitful weights?
translations.asv: Shall I be pure with wicked balances, and with a bag of deceitful weights?
